name: Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz
shortBio: Hieronymite nun, polymath, and Mexican early modern philosopher whose epistemological poetry and treatises defended universal intellectual agency and women's right to philosophical inquiry.
centralQuestion: Can reason and the pursuit of knowledge be legitimately denied to women by theological or patriarchal authority?

keyWorks.title: Primero Sueño (First Dream)
keyWorks.description: Epistemological dream poem exploring the soul's ascent toward the cosmos, confronting the limits and noble ambition of human cognition.

keyWorks.title: Respuesta a Sor Filotea de la Cruz
keyWorks.description: Landmark philosophical and autobiographical defense of women's right to study, teach, and interpret philosophy and scripture.
